description.value:
1 to 2

You activate dampeners in your exocortex that slow motion and dilate time. Either you, your exocortex, or one of your Deployed Mines emits a @Template[emanation|distance:10] of difficult terrain for a number of rounds equal to your Intelligence modifier. You and your exocortex are unhindered by difficult terrain created this way.

You can Deploy Motion Dampener as 2 actions. When you do, you Deploy the Motion Dampener into an unoccupied space within 30 feet of you. This cloaking field is immobile and can't be moved.
